HIRING: Frontend Developer (Contract) | Remote (UK/EU preferred)

We’re building a privacy-first, edge-AI camera platform. Our devices run local AI inference and stream directly from hardware (SigmaStar cameras → RTSP/ONVIF → HDMI node → on-device AI).

We are looking for a frontend developer on a short contract to rebuild the public company website.

Contract

Start: April 2026 (latest)

Length: 1–2 months

Focus: website build only (not product frontend)

What you’ll own

· Building the full company marketing website · Interactive elements including a 3D globe showing camera locations · Clean, modern UI with strong performance and responsiveness

Skills

· Strong HTML / CSS / JavaScript · React or similar modern frontend frameworks · Experience with interactive or 3D web elements (WebGL / Three.js / similar is a plus) · Good design judgement and attention to detail · Able to work fast and independently (short contract)

If this sounds interesting, feel free to reach out: ayeeye.careers@gmail.com (Subject: HN – Frontend Contract)
